digest.component_or_area: git blame metrics and bug close derivation
propositions: Clone guidance must document that --filter=blob:none reduces size from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB and time from 59 s to 14.3 s, while --filter=tree:0 must never be used due to producing 3.57 GiB (3.4x larger)
_blame_file_commits currently returns [] for both git failure and successful-but-empty results, making them indistinguishable and preventing proper error handling
derive_caused_by can compute wrong caused_by links when blame succeeds on some paths and fails on others, because the majority test runs over a partial subset instead of the full set
_blame_file_commits must be changed to return None on git failure and [] on successful-but-empty result, then derive_caused_by must abort and return None when any path blame returns None
Legitimate empty file blames (zero lines) must not abort derivation, only actual git command failures should
derive_caused_by must not write a caused_by link event when any per-path blame fails
